title: Young Lady, You Will be Punished

text_block_list.text: Yet another punishment to ME, a noble and peerless being, unbelievable! I CANNOT ACCEPT THIS AT AAAAAAAALL!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
高貴なあたくし様に更なるお罰だなんて！
ビタイチ納得できねぇですわ～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: Ah, Lord Kishi-san, it seems Kanon-san messed up again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
騎士殿さ～ん
カノンさんがまたやらかしまして～……

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: In the aftermath of the battle, I accidentally broke a child’s toy and was forced to perform street tricks! Then they had the gall to silence me for my noble laughter...! I will pay you back for all those unreasonable punishments a trillion times over, Nephi Nela!
text_block_list.orig_text:
戦闘の余波で子どものオモチャを壊したら
大道芸をやらされたり、
あたくし様の高貴な高笑いに対して口封じの刑を下したり……
理不尽な処罰の数々、
いずれお兆倍にして返しますわよネフィ＝ネラ！

text_block_list.name: Miia
text_block_list.text: And that's about how it usually goes~ Even after getting punished by the Princess, she never learns her lesson~
text_block_list.orig_text:
と、
こんな調子なんですよ～
媛さまにお仕置きされても
全然懲りた様子がないんですよね～

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: My, what an honor, my dear Lord Kishi. You have come at just the right moment. When I try to discipline her, it only seems to stoke her resentment even more. I am at my wit’s end, everything I do only fans Kanon’s rebellious flame.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これは騎士殿。
折良き所に参られたものよ。
わっちでは灸を据えども、
ただ恨みを熱っするかの如し也。
カノンの叛骨を煽るばかり故、
ほとほと困り果てて候。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Therefore, for a little while, I would like to borrow your wisdom as to how handle Kanon. A bitter draught from you, Lord Kishi, might just serve as the medicine she needs.
text_block_list.orig_text:
故に暫時の間、
カノン奴について
お前さまの御知恵を拝借したく思い侍り。
騎士殿から飲まされる苦杯ならば、
あるいは良薬となるやもしれませぬ。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: HEY! What are you deciding over there on your own?! I would not forgive you even in a million years for all the humiliations I have suffered, Nephy! Just what kind of thinking are you employing to make Lowborn punish me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと！　
なに勝手にお決めになってらっしゃいますの！？
あたくしを負かしたネフィなら
一億万歩譲って許しませんけども！？
馬ボーンにあたくし様のお仕置きをさせるって
どういうお了見ですの！？

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Your kindness is deeply appreciated, Lord Kishi. Now... if I may be so bold as to offer one suggestion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿の慈心、
誠に重畳に存じまする。
では──
僭越ながら
一つだけ献言を。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: A beast cannot be tamed with just a whip, nor just with a treat. Only when both wheels turn together can the cart move forward.
text_block_list.orig_text:
獣を御するには鞭だけでも、
ましてや飴だけでも成り立ちませぬ。
両輪は揃えてこそ
で御座りんす。

text_block_list.name: Kanon
text_block_list.text: DON'T JUST IGNORE THE PERSON INVOLVED AND GO AHEAD WITH NO REGARD! I WILL ABSOLUTELY NEVER GIVE IN TO A LOWBORN LIKE YOU!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お当事者を無視して話を進めるんじゃねえですわ！
あたくし様は
こんな馬ボーンに
絶対屈したりなんてしねえんですからね～！！
